VC.nose_turning: <= 17.10 deg (VC: 16.9 + 0.2) at every ring node but the trailing-edge corners and geometry kinks (law 1)
VC.geometry_kinks: <= 17.10 deg (VC's turning limit): a kink of the section itself (trailing-edge opening on very small chords) that no cell size can reduce
VC.chord_growth: <= 1.25 (VC) within 1 % (the lower side follows the upper side's arc fraction; where the two noses differ, open decision 64, its first cells grow a little faster)
VC.band_spacing: <= 1 x the band cell asked at VC (bubble length / 9.1), within 1 %
VC.te_spacing: <= 1 x the trailing-edge cell asked at VC (0.169 % c; law 3), within 1 %
VC.loft_stations_hit: a station exactly on every loft station [m]

VC.planar_stations: every ring in its station plane [m]
VC.cap_quads: >= 0.05 (scaled Jacobian, all but the two nose-corner cells)
VC.cap_nose_corners: > 0, not folded (the H cap puts two corners on the smooth nose: angle 180 deg - turning)
